# Papa Perez FC

> Official website of Papa Perez FC, an amateur football (soccer) club founded in 2025 at the Institute of Management Sciences (IMSciences), Peshawar, Pakistan. Club motto: "Loved, Despised, Never Ignored."

## Pages

- [Home](https://aadilkk18.github.io/PapaPerez/): About the club, full squad list with positions and shirt numbers, and contact details.

## Contact

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/papaperezfc
- Location: IMSciences, Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
